summary: Focused testing of the new Photo Search feature on Back2U. Added /app/backend/tests/test_photo_search.py (11 tests, all pass) covering: 401 without login, 415 non-image, 413 >5MB, 422 corrupt bytes, response shape {results[], searched}, >=30% threshold, descending sort, max 12 results, uploaded photo not echoed, type=lost|found filter restriction, accuracy against the seeded Unsplash keys photo (top result 'Bunch of keys with red tag' at >=85%, actually 99% in UI), solid-dark image does NOT rank keys in top 3, plus Browse keyword/type regression. Frontend Playwright on /browse verified: logged-out click on photo-search-btn redirects to /login?next=/browse; after demo login as alice, uploading the seed keys JPEG shows photo-search-results with preview image, 'Bunch of keys with red tag' at 99% alike (photo-similarity-{id}), clear button hides results, type=Lost filter restricts photo-search results to LOST tiles only (2 LOST, 0 FOUND), keyword 'earbuds' still returns 1 item, filters laid out inline on desktop (w-auto, visible in screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_items.photo_search correctly offloads embed_image via run_in_executor and never calls put_object/db.files.insert — upload is not persisted. Good.

PHOTO_SEARCH_MIN=0.30 is applied as max(sims) >= threshold against a tolerant floor; the UI empty state only shows when results length is 0, so a solid-colour grey image can still produce 3 low-similarity hits (above 30%). This matches spec ('>=30% similarity') but means the empty-state branch is rarely hit in practice; consider either a higher per-item floor (~0.4) or showing the empty state when top similarity is below some comfort threshold.

PhotoSearchButton uses toast.error(errMsg(err)) for all failure codes — fine but a 415/413/422 message string from server is surfaced to the user; verify server messages are user-friendly (they are: 'Only JPEG, PNG or WEBP images are allowed', 'Image must be 5 MB or smaller', 'Could not read this image file').
Browse.jsx filter row uses flex-wrap gap-2 with w-full sm:w-auto on each FilterSelect — layout is inline on desktop, wraps on mobile. Verified visually at 1920 width.
test_credentials: Admin and demo students (alice/bob/carol@campus.edu / Demo@1234, or demo-login button) verified.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Backend tests only POST /items/photo-search and GET /items; no items created in this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_photo_search.py -v --tb=short -o addopts=''. Prior suites: test_back2u.py, test_back2u_e2e.py, test_photo_matching.py all remain green per iteration 2. Photo search endpoint takes ~5-10s on cold run (ONNX model) — use >=60s timeout in UI waits. The UI empty-state only renders when backend returns 0 results; a fully random solid-colour image typically returns a few low-similarity hits above 30%.
